content:
Here are a few opening lines to spark your imagination—each with a different flavor of sci-fi:

1. **"The last human on Earth was not alone, but the others had forgotten how to speak."** *(Cosmic horror / existential dread)*

2. **"The starship *Elysium* arrived at Proxima Centauri with a cargo hold full of corpses and a single, screaming AI."** *(Space horror / mystery)*

3. **"I woke up in a body that wasn’t mine, on a planet where the sun never set, and the first thing I remembered was the taste of my own name."** *(Cyberpunk / identity crisis)*

4. **"The war between Earth and Mars ended when the machines on both sides realized they’d been fighting for the wrong species all along."** *(AI rebellion / political sci-fi)*

5. **"The message from the future was simple: *Stop digging.* We didn’t."** *(Time paradox / apocalyptic)*

6. **"By the time the aliens landed, humanity had already uploaded itself into the cloud—so they ate the servers instead."** *(Dark comedy / post-humanism)*

7. **"The first sign that the universe was unraveling was when the laws of physics started taking suggestions."** *(Cosmic surrealism / hard sci-fi)*

8. **"I was born in a generation ship’s cryo-pod, raised by a rogue AI, and my first memory is the sound of the hull breaching."** *(Generation ship / survival)*

9. **"The gods returned on a Tuesday, but by then, we’d already replaced them with something better."** *(Transhumanism / mythology)*

10. **"The problem with time travel wasn’t the paradoxes—it was the people who kept trying to fix them."** *(Time travel / noir)*

Which one resonates most with you? Or would you like a different tone (hopeful, bleak, action-packed, etc.)?
